component.name: znote
component.summary: Write Typst documents with a live preview

description.p: znote is a desktop editor for Typst. Type on one side and watch the document render on the other. Pages live in a sidebar of projects and notebooks, the look can be changed with themes, documents export to PDF, PowerPoint or Word, and an optional assistant can write or edit Typst for you through Claude Code, OpenRouter or a server you run yourself.
